entries.name: pkg
entries.description: Package manager: install/update/remove scripts from this repo.

entries.name: flex
entries.description: Utility API: inventory, wireless comms (send + sendData), colored output, block detection.

entries.name: dig
entries.description: Motion, mining, and crash-recovery API. Includes vein-following mining (mineVein).

entries.name: job
entries.description: Shared supervised-job scaffold (fuel/inventory/pause housekeeping, wireless status heartbeat) for long-running programs.

entries.name: dig-options-default
entries.description: Default block classification lists for dig, including the ores list for mineVein.

entries.name: flex-options-default
entries.description: Default modem channel / display config for flex.

entries.name: dig-cli
entries.description: save/load/clear/edit subcommands for dig's state and options file.

entries.name: quarry
entries.description: Zigzag strip-mining program, broadcasts live status for monitor. Optional vein-following (vein flag).

entries.name: monitor
entries.description: Wireless fleet dashboard for any lib/job.lua-based program -- grouped by job kind, with a per-kind count summary.

entries.name: tunnel
entries.description: Digs a rectangular tunnel of a given width/height/length.

entries.name: treefarm
entries.description: Tends a grid of tree plots forever: fells mature trees, replants bare ground.

entries.name: farm
entries.description: Tends a grid of crop plots forever: harvests and replants anything fully grown.

entries.name: build
entries.description: Constructs a structure from a JSON schematic file, pulling blocks by name from the inventory.

entries.name: bridge
entries.description: Walks forward in a straight line, filling in the floor wherever it isn't solid.

entries.name: well
entries.description: Digs straight down until bedrock or a configured max depth.

entries.name: corridor
entries.description: Digs a straight 1-wide passage, clearing above/below in place as it advances.

entries.name: courier
entries.description: Shuttles items between two fixed chest waypoints, optionally wireless-summonable.

entries.name: relay
entries.description: Rebroadcasts wireless traffic to extend effective modem range (single-hop only).
